info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Airline Flights Cancel-v4-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Cancellation API allows users to cancel scheduled flights efficiently. This API is designed for airlines and travel management systems, enabling them to manage flight cancellations in bulk. It supports operations that update flight status and ensures compliance with airline policies. Typical consumers include airline operators and travel agents seeking to streamline their flight management processes.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a previously booked flight. Ensure you have the necessary permissions to perform this action. Once a flight is canceled, it cannot be reactivated.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel an existing flight. The client must provide the necessary flight details to successfully process the cancellation.

200.description: The flight cancellation request was successfully processed.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling a flight operation. The content is expected to be a string.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.title: Flight Cancel Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the flight after the cancellation request.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message regarding the cancellation operation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the cancellation operation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.description: Response schema for the successful cancellation of a flight.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Contains details regarding the audit of the operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value helps in evaluating the performance of the operation.
